scoring_justification: Recompute power-law exponent b from raw data.csv (log-log linear regression) and compare to paper-reported value 2.02 within tolerance ±0.1.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference exponent b=2.02 and ideal glass transition temperature T0=0.27 for the Kob-Andersen model.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 3(a) and text: 'b = 2.02 ± 0.03', T0 determined from VFT fit (FIG. S3).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper's reported values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers from the paper's analysis; the task goal is to reproduce them.

schema.notes: At least 10 rows; at least 2 distinct condition values.

outputs.description: Raw dissipation data: loss phase angle δ versus configurational distance ISD_min for multiple conditions and temperatures.
Fitted power-law exponent and quality of the δ ∝ ISD_min^b relation for temperatures above T0.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute the power-law exponent from data.csv using a log‑log linear regression on the subset of points with temperature > T0 (hidden threshold). It will then compare the recomputed exponent to the paper‑reported reference value. The fit_results.json exponent_b must be consistent with the recomputed value (within a narrow tolerance) to earn a consistency bonus.

steps.description: Recompute power-law exponent b from data.csv filtered T>T0; compare to paper reference 2.02 within tolerance ±0.1. Also enforce shape: at least 10 rows and 2 distinct conditions.
Verify fit_results.json exponent_b matches recomputed exponent within 0.02 and R_squared >= 0.9.
